projects.title: Design HOPES — Home–Health Environment Assessment
projects.description: Developing a toolkit to help healthcare practitioners assess the home environment as part of health and care. Built with Laura MacLean and Parastoo Sali, the work connects building and indoor environment evidence to clinical practice, supported by engagement workshops and design experiences. Part of the AHRC-funded Design HOPES programme.

projects.title: Humans in the Loop — Physiological Sensing for Sufficiency-Oriented Retrofit
projects.description: A planned programme integrating physiological sensing with indoor environmental and energy monitoring, to right-size retrofit strategies around occupant needs considering planetary boundaries

projects.title: MIESDOC – Modelling Innovative Scenarios for Future Domestic Comfort
projects.description: Exploring advanced building performance simulations for future energy retrofitting scenarios, with a focus on occupant comfort and energy demand under different climate trajectories.
projects.funding: Eindhoven Institute for Renewable Energy Systems (EIRES)

projects.title: Unintended Consequences of Energy Retrofits on Hygrothermal Performance
projects.description: Systematic review and simulation study of energy retrofits and their inadvertent hygrothermal repercussions in residential building stock. Developed a framework for identifying moisture risk in retrofit scenarios across Pacific Northwest climates.

projects.title: CD-Ines — IT Tool for Airtightness Prediction
projects.description: Developed an IT tool with predictive capabilities for airtightness levels in pre-existing residential buildings in Chile. The tool was validated against blower-door test measurements.

projects.title: FONDEF VIU – Prefabricated Cladding System for Energy Retrofit
projects.description: Tested strategies to elevate airtightness in low-income housing. Developed a patent-pending prefabricated cladding system designed for rapid deployment in social housing retrofit programs.
